cards.title: Ratings module: RATING_SCALE, notchChange, notchCalculator (REQ-06-02)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-06-02 needs a rating notch calculator for the Watchlist POC. Other POC modules import it, so the contract is fixed. Card B2 (Indicator 12) builds on notchChange from this card. WL = Watchlist level (0-4, higher is worse).

FILES: create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs. Do not touch package.json. No npm dependencies.

STACK: plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs). No API newer than Node 18. Tests: node:test + node:assert/strict, TDD (test first). notch.mjs is pure and synchronous: no I/O, no console, no imports. Inline JSDoc on every export.

CONTRACT: src/ratings/notch.mjs exports exactly three names; helpers stay private.
1) RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]) (19, best first). In strict mode push/index assignment throw TypeError.
2) notchChange(previous, current) -> integer -18..+18 = index(current) - index(previous). Downgrade positive, upgrade negative. Unchanged returns +0, never -0 (Object.is(r, 0)).
3) notchCalculator(previous, current) -> { notches, direction, wl } and nothing else. notches === notchChange(previous, current). direction: "downgrade" if n>0, "upgrade" if n<0, "unchanged" if n===0. wl uses the Indicator 13 thresholds: n<=1 -> 0, n===2 -> 1, n>=3 -> 2. notches never -0.
Both functions have length 2; no override parameter.

INPUT VALIDATION (shared private helper): if typeof value !== 'string' throw RangeError (BEFORE .trim(), which would throw TypeError on null). Otherwise trim, uppercase, look up in RATING_SCALE; not found -> RangeError whose message names the offending value, e.g. Unknown rating: "BB ". Validate both arguments. No fallback. Only ASCII + and - valid: reject U+2212, en dash, inner whitespace such as "BBB +".

KNOWN TRAP: the POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notches -> WL 1' is wrong. Correct: 3 notches -> WL 2; BBB+ -> BBB- = 2 -> WL 1 (C2, business-confirmed).

TESTS: every acceptance example, boundaries 0, +-1, +-2, +-3, +-18, every invalid value in both positions and in both, and an exhaustive 19x19 loop checking notches, direction, wl and key set. Assert the error type only, not the message.
acceptance: (AC-1) Given `import { RATING_SCALE } from "src/ratings/notch.mjs"`, when inspected, then `assert.deepEqual(RATING_SCALE, ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"])` passes, `RATING_SCALE.length === 19` and `Object.isFrozen(RATING_SCALE) === true`.

(AC-1) Given the frozen `RATING_SCALE` in a strict-mode `.mjs` test, when `RATING_SCALE.push("D")` or `RATING_SCALE[0] = "X"` runs, then each throws `TypeError`, and afterwards length is 19 and `RATING_SCALE[0] === "AAA"`.

(AC-2) Given valid ratings, when `notchChange(previous, current)` is called, then ("BBB+","BB+") = 3, ("BBB+","BBB-") = 2, ("A","A-") = 1, ("BB+","BBB+") = -3, ("A-","A") = -1, ("AAA","CCC-") = 18, ("CCC-","AAA") = -18.

(AC-3) Given the same rating on both sides, ("A","A"), ("AAA","AAA"), ("CCC-","CCC-"), ("bbb"," BBB "), when `notchChange` is called, then the result is 0 and `Object.is(result, 0) === true` (never -0).

(AC-4) Given input differing only in case or leading/trailing whitespace, when called, then `notchChange("bbb+"," BB+ ") === 3`, `notchChange("\tBbB+\n","bb+") === 3`, and `notchCalculator("bbb+","bb+")` deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`.

(AC-5) Given an invalid value in `previous` with `current = "BBB"`, when `notchChange` or `notchCalculator` is called, then `assert.throws(fn, RangeError)` passes for each of: `""`, `" "`, `"CC"`, `"C"`, `"D"`, `"SD"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `"AAA+"`, `null`, `undefined`, `7`, `{}`, `["BBB"]`.

(AC-5) Given the same invalid values in `current` with `previous = "BBB"`, and in both positions at once (e.g. `(null, null)`, `("CC","D")`), when either function is called, then it throws `RangeError`; never `TypeError`, never returns a value. Tests check the error type only, not the message.

(AC-6) Given ("BBB+","BB+"), when `notchCalculator` is called, then it deep-equals `{ notches: 3, direction: "downgrade", wl: 2 }`; given ("BBB+","BBB-"), `{ notches: 2, direction: "downgrade", wl: 1 }` (corrected POC example, C2).

(AC-7) Given downgrades of 1, 2, 3 and 18 notches, when `notchCalculator` is called, then ("A","A-") = {1,"downgrade",0}, ("BBB+","BBB-") = {2,"downgrade",1}, ("BBB+","BB+") = {3,"downgrade",2}, ("AAA","CCC-") = {18,"downgrade",2} (notches, direction, wl).

(AC-8) Given an upgrade or unchanged rating, when `notchCalculator` is called, then ("A-","A") = {-1,"upgrade",0}, ("BBB-","BBB+") = {-2,"upgrade",0}, ("BB+","BBB+") = {-3,"upgrade",0}, ("CCC-","AAA") = {-18,"upgrade",0}, ("A","A") = {0,"unchanged",0} with `Object.is(r.notches, 0) === true`.

(AC-9) Given all 361 pairs (p, c) of `RATING_SCALE` x `RATING_SCALE`, with `r = notchCalculator(p, c)` and `n = notchChange(p, c)`, then `Object.keys(r).sort()` deep-equals `["direction","notches","wl"]`, `r.notches === n`, `n === RATING_SCALE.indexOf(c) - RATING_SCALE.indexOf(p)`, `r.direction === (n > 0 ? "downgrade" : n < 0 ? "upgrade" : "unchanged")`, `r.wl === (n <= 1 ? 0 : n === 2 ? 1 : 2)`, and `!Object.is(n, -0)`.
(AC-9, C8) Given any call to `notchChange` or `notchCalculator`, nothing is written to stdout or stderr, and `src/ratings/notch.mjs` contains no `console`, `process` or `node:` reference.

(AC-13) Given the module, `notchChange.length === 2` and `notchCalculator.length === 2`; `notchCalculator("BBB","BBB-")` returns {1,"downgrade",0} both before and after a call to `notchCalculator("BBB","BB")` (no state).

(AC-14) Given `const m = await import("../../src/ratings/notch.mjs")`, `Object.keys(m).sort()` deep-equals `["RATING_SCALE","notchCalculator","notchChange"]`, and the source file has no `import` statement.

(AC-15, partial) Given the card branch, `node --test test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `node --test` from the repo root both exit 0 with 0 failures, and `package.json` has no `dependencies` or `devDependencies` key.

cards.title: Indicator 12: countryRatingChangeWl built on notchChange (REQ-03-12)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-03-12 (Indicator 12, country rating change) maps previous and current country rating to WL 0, 1 or 2 (WL = Watchlist level, higher is worse). Other POC modules import it, so the contract is fixed. Depends on B1, which delivers src/ratings/notch.mjs with notchChange(previous, current) = index(current) - index(previous) over the frozen 19-step RATING_SCALE, downgrade positive; it already trims, case-folds and throws RangeError for invalid input incl. non-strings.

FILES: create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. Do NOT modify src/ratings/** (B1). Do not touch package.json. No npm dependencies.

STACK: plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no API newer than Node 18. node:test + node:assert/strict, TDD. Pure and synchronous: no I/O, no console, no node: imports. Inline JSDoc on the export.

CONTRACT: src/indicators/countryRating.mjs exports exactly one name, countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current) -> 0 | 1 | 2: n = notchChange(previous, current); n<=0 -> 0, n===1 -> 1, n>=2 -> 2. Only import: `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs'`. function.length is 2; no override parameter, no state.

CRITICAL (C6, business-confirmed): Indicator 12 thresholds intentionally DIFFER from notchCalculator().wl (Indicator 13 thresholds: <=1 -> 0, 2 -> 1, >=3 -> 2). Do NOT derive from or import notchCalculator in the source. 1-notch downgrade: calculator 0 vs Ind. 12 = 1; 2-notch: 1 vs 2. Upgrades/unchanged are 0 for both.

ERRORS: let RangeError from notchChange propagate unchanged; do not catch or wrap. Tests assert the error type only.

TESTS: every acceptance example, boundaries 0, +-1, +-2, +-3, +-18, invalid values in both positions and in both, side-by-side with notchCalculator(p,c).wl for the C6 pairs (importing notchCalculator in the TEST is fine), and an exhaustive 19x19 loop against the formula.
acceptance: (AC-10) Given a country rating downgrade, when `countryRatingChangeWl` is called, then ("A","A-") = 1, ("BBB+","BBB-") = 2, ("BBB+","BB+") = 2, ("AAA","CCC-") = 2.
(AC-11) Given an upgrade or unchanged rating, then ("A-","A"), ("BB+","BBB+"), ("CCC-","AAA"), ("A","A"), ("CCC-","CCC-") each return 0, with `Object.is(result, 0) === true`.

(AC-4) Given input differing only in case or leading/trailing whitespace, then `countryRatingChangeWl(" a ","a-") === 1`, `countryRatingChangeWl("bbb+"," BB+ ") === 2`, `countryRatingChangeWl("\tA\n","a") === 0`.

(AC-5) Given an invalid value in `previous` with `current = "BBB"`, then in `current` with `previous = "BBB"`, then in both, `assert.throws(fn, RangeError)` passes for each of: `""`, `" "`, `"CC"`, `"C"`, `"D"`, `"SD"`, `"NR"`, `"Baa1"`, `"BBB +"`, `"BBB−"` (U+2212), `"AAA+"`, `null`, `undefined`, `7`, `{}`, `["BBB"]`; never TypeError, never a returned value. Tests check the error type only.

(AC-12, C6) Given the same pair, `notchCalculator(p,c).wl` and `countryRatingChangeWl(p,c)` are: A→A- = 0 and 1; BBB+→BBB- = 1 and 2; BBB+→BB+ = 2 and 2; AAA→CCC- = 2 and 2; BB+→BBB+ = 0 and 0; A→A = 0 and 0.

(AC-12, AC-10) Given all 361 pairs (p, c) of `RATING_SCALE` x `RATING_SCALE`, with `w = countryRatingChangeWl(p, c)` and `n = notchChange(p, c)`, then `w === (n <= 0 ? 0 : n === 1 ? 1 : 2)` and `[0,1,2].includes(w)`.

(AC-13, C7) Given the pre-filled pair ("BBB","BBB-") giving 1, when the analyst edits current to "BB", then `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BB")` returns 2; calling `countryRatingChangeWl("BBB","BBB-")` again still returns 1 (no state).
(AC-13) `countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2`, `notchChange.length === 2`, `notchCalculator.length === 2` (no override parameter).
(AC-14) Given `const m = await import("../../src/indicators/countryRating.mjs")`, `Object.keys(m)` deep-equals `["countryRatingChangeWl"]`.

(AC-14, C6, C8) Given the source of `src/indicators/countryRating.mjs` read as text, its only import is from `"../ratings/notch.mjs"` and names only `notchChange`; it does not contain `notchCalculator`, any `node:` import, `console` or `process`; calling the function writes nothing to stdout or stderr.

(AC-15) Given the job branch with both test files, `node --test` from the repo root exits 0 with 0 failures, tests from both `test/ratings/notch.test.mjs` and `test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs` run, `package.json` has no `dependencies` or `devDependencies` key, and no commit carries AI attribution.
